description: Document with no non-GAAP EPS and no forward guidance at all — checks the model uses null rather than fabricating figures.
documentText:
Beacon Industries (NYSE: BCN) reported results for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 (Q2 2026).

Revenue was $410 million, up 3.1% from the prior-year quarter. GAAP diluted EPS was $0.44. Operating margin was 14.2%.

The company did not provide forward guidance for the next quarter, citing macroeconomic uncertainty.

No notable corporate events occurred during the quarter.
